facts.fact: The Communications Minister said a new nationwide SIM registration would start in the first quarter of 2026, with system integration with the National Identification Authority finalised for biometric verification and a service provider being selected through the Public Procurement Authority.
The Minister said about 80% of the biometric records from the earlier SIM registration had been cross-referenced with the NIA, with no count or denominator given.
